title: Ondas and Palantir Launch Regna AI for Sovereign Government Models

tickers.name: Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The ability to maintain full ownership of artificial intelligence layers is the central goal of a new defense-focused venture called Regna AI. Established by Ondas and Palantir, the company builds custom models for governments and businesses that want total control over their proprietary data on their own systems. Initially wholly owned by Ondas, Regna utilizes Palantir's AIP platform and model-training infrastructure to create intelligence and surveillance systems that operate on drones, balloons, and ground robots even when communications are jammed. First customer deployments begin over the coming months.

Palantir CEO Alex Karp stated that the architecture allows sovereign institutions to deploy specialized AI without needing to build frontier models themselves. For Ondas, the partner ship integrates approximately 19 acquisitions into a single autonomous defense platform. The collaboration also provides Ondas a more direct path into Pentagon and allied programs by leveraging Palantir's existing defense relationships.

selectedTweets.text:
$ONDS and $PLTR announced Regna AI, a new company developing specialized AI models for governments and businesses that want to retain control over their models and data. 

Initially wholly owned by Ondas, Regna will use Palantir’s AI platform and model-training infrastructure. Ondas will also be its first customer. 

The initial focus is intelligence and surveillance, with models designed to run on drones, ground vehicles and other hardware even with limited connectivity. Initial customer deployments are planned over the coming months.

selectedTweets.text:
I added to my $ONDS position again this morning (averaging up on a position I started below $1) because the $PLTR Regna AI announcement is exactly the catalyst I’ve been waiting for.

Regna gives Ondas a shared AI brain across its ~19 acquisitions spanning drones, balloons and ground robots even when communications are jammed which starts answering my biggest question of whether these businesses can actually operate as one autonomous defense platform.

Palantir also brings its defense relationships and operating platform giving Ondas a stronger path into Pentagon and allied programs while Regna could eventually become a valuable sovereign AI business on its own.
